expires.description: The last day the licence is valid, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC), inclusive.

grace_days.description: Days after `expires` during which the state is `grace` rather than `expired`.

issued.description: The issue date, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). A date after today is reported as a tamper note.

key_id.description: Which issuer key signed this file.

team_id.description: The team the licence is for (one licence, one team).

LicenceState.description: The state a licence is in. Every state is reported; none changes what the engines compute.

oneOf.description: Signed by a trusted key and within its term.
Past `expires` and past its grace days.
A file was found but is not a licence this binary accepts; `reason` says why.
No licence file at any of the three locations.
One team, unlimited users and runs, CI included.

description: The full status, as `mununu licence status --json` and `GET /api/v1/licence` report it.

claims.description: The claims, when the payload parsed (present for `invalid` too when the file was readable as claims, so a wrong-key or expired file still says whose it is).

days_left.description: Days until `expires`: `0` on the last valid day, negative after it. Present when the dates parsed.

note.description: A tamper note: `issued` is after today, so the file or the host clock is wrong.

source.description: The file the status describes; absent when `missing`.

title: LicenceStatus
